title: review-run error envelope
description: Printed instead of a result on exit 1, 2, 10, 11, 12 (outside a run), 13 (a pre-run hook), 20 and 21. A resolve-step forgectl failure exits 10 (code not_found) or 12 (code failed, lower_code, details.retry_after when given). export prints audit.jsonl or log.jsonl lines, described by audit.json and log.json; it has no cli schema.
